fullContentHtml:
Haryana HTET Form November 2026 - Complete Details

Haryana HTET Form November 2026: The Board of School Education, Haryana (BSEH) has announced that the Haryana Teacher Eligibility Test (HTET) will be held in November 2026. Online application process is scheduled to begin on the official portal. Eligible candidates can check details, syllabus, eligibility criteria and important dates below.

Important Dates

  • Organization : Board of School Education, Haryana (BSEH)
  • Exam Name : Haryana Teacher Eligibility Test (HTET)
  • Application Mode : Online
  • Job Location : Haryana
  • Start Date : September 2026 (Expected)
  • Last Date : October 2026 (Expected)
  • Exam Date : 21 & 22 November 2026 (Expected)

Application Fee

  • General / OBC / Other State (Single Paper) : Rs. 1000/-
  • SC / PH of Haryana (Single Paper) : Rs. 500/-
  • General / OBC / Other State (Double Paper) : Rs. 1800/-
  • SC / PH of Haryana (Double Paper) : Rs. 900/-
  • General / OBC / Other State (Triple Paper) : Rs. 2400/-
  • SC / PH of Haryana (Triple Paper) : Rs. 1200/-
  • Payment Mode : Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI

Eligibility Criteria

  • Level-I PRT: 12th Pass + D.Ed. (Diploma in Education)
  • Level-II TGT: Graduate + B.Ed. (Degree in Education)
  • Level-III PGT: Post Graduate + B.Ed.

Important Links

  • Short Notification PDF
  • Official Website
